name: Clover Android SDK
summary: The app's primary data surface: orders, merchants, and connectors come from the Clover SDK in-process (AIDL), not a REST API.
auth: Clover app connection (connect the app from the App Market preview)

notes.body: You must connect the app from the App Market preview before any Clover data is available - see README.md.

name: MessageBird Conversations API
summary: The app's only REST interface (Retrofit) - sends order emails/SMS and reads customer conversations by order.

notes.body: Defined in app/src/main/java/com/orderMate/networkManager/ApiCall.kt; this is the surface the Kotlin endpoints extractor documents.

name: OpenHands Cloud
summary: Autonomous-dev and complex-logic automations that pick up GitHub issues for this repo and open pull requests.

notes.body: Triggered via the shared Postman collection; the same collection covers BusyBuddy_v2 and Orbit.

name: Pipeline Orchestrator (agent-ops)
summary: The agent-ops control repo whose pipelines.yaml registers this repo's automation entry and whose shared workflow generates this docs site.

notes.body: The Automation page is generated from this repo's entry in agent-ops's orchestrator/src/registry/pipelines.yaml.
